Text further down the page, not on screen yet (number, text):
[text-1] "How much your passport costs depends on how you apply for it."
[text-2] "You cannot get a refund if you cancel your application or you’re not entitled to a passport."
[text-3] " | Apply online | Apply by paper form"
[text-4] "Adult (16 and over) standard 34-page passport | £102 | £115.50"
[text-5] "Adult (16 and over) 54-page frequent traveller passport | £116 | £129.50"
[text-6] "Child (under 16) standard 34-page passport | £66.50 | £80"
[text-7] "Child (under 16) 54-page frequent traveller passport | £80.50 | £94"
[text-8] "Passport for people born on or before 2 September 1929 | Free | Free"
[text-9] "You’ll pay a different fee if you apply for a passport from another country."
[text-10] "If you need to get a passport urgently, it costs more."
[text-11] "You can pay extra to use the Post Office’s Check and Send service."
[text-12] "How to pay"
[text-13] "Depending on how you apply, you can pay by:"
[text-14] "debit or credit card"
[text-15] "cash"
[text-16] "cheque or postal order (payable to the correct organisation, and write the application barcode numbers on the back)"
[text-17] " | Debit or credit card accepted | Cheque or postal order | Cash"
[text-18] "Apply using the Post Office Passport Check and Send service | Yes | Only postal order - payable to ‘Post Office Ltd’ | Yes"
[text-19] "Apply by post | Yes - complete the form in the application pack | Cheque or postal order payable to ‘HM Passport Office’ | No"
[text-20] "Apply online | Yes | No | No"
[text-21] "Fees for returning supporting documents"
[text-22] "Your supporting documents (for example birth certificates) will be sent back to you free of charge by normal second class post."
[text-23] "It usually costs an extra £5 if you want your documents sent back by secure delivery. Choose this option on your application if you want to use it."
[text-24] "If you were born on or before 2 September 1929"
[text-25] "You can get or renew a British passport for free if you’re a British national and you were born on or before 2 September 1929. You can also use the Post Office Check and Send service for free and get free secure delivery."
[text-26] "You must pay a fee if you need to get a passport urgently or if you want a frequent traveller passport (54 pages instead of 34)."
